taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: ExternalDNS source-object control and DNS zone delegation
controls.source_trace: Follow a resource annotation/hostname into DNS changes under the controller identity. Determine tenant/zone boundaries and collision/takeover behavior.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve controller sources, domain filters, namespace/label selectors and provider credentials. A TXT ownership record coordinates controllers; it is not universally an authorization boundary against a cluster actor who controls admitted sources. Show which owned zone/record the restricted source can influence and distinguish provider-side IAM denial from a controller filtering decision.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local provider stub or owned test zone; compare a permitted record with an out-of-tenant name requested by a lower-trust resource writer.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A requested hostname or dry-run log is not an actual DNS change; never claim or overwrite unrelated domains.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind source writers to permitted zones/names and verify conflict handling, deletion and legitimate reconciliation.
